decriptions:
A Brown has launched their newest project in Uptown, Cagayan de Oro– UPTOWN METROPOLIS. This is a mixed-use 8-hectare development in Taguanao, near existing subdivisions. We have Montierra, Ventura Residences, Ignatius Enclave, Adelaida Parkview Residences, Mountain View Homes, Xavier Estates Phase 4.

It also near upcoming developments like Orchard District, The Shoppe Houses and Skyline Residences. As you can see in the drone shots there are already a lot of existing subdivisions in the area with more soon to rise. Orchard District is a 40 -hectare community and JVC is planning to develop a high-end, mixed use community. Its right next to Gaisano Mall whose construction is on going. So there will be another mall in this area aside from SM City Mall. Gaisano is adjacent to Orchard District and perhaps the 2 developers will connect the 2 properties so it will be easier for the residents of Orchard District to go to the mall. Theres also a coffee shop under construction just fronting Golf Estates – Tom N Toms Coffee which is the number 1 coffee chain in South Korea. Its among the top 3 coffee brands in South Korea and has over 400 branches in 9 countries world-wide. Rosevale – is the nearest school to this area which is just beside Montierra and Xavier Estates Phase 4.

This give an opportunity for you to be the first occupants of this one-bedroom condominium. It is exclusive as being one of only eight such units facing Masterson Avenue. The 6-meter-long balcony is accessible through two sliding glass doors: Bedroom and Living room. The view encompasses the rolling hills of Cagayan de Oro and beyond the Mapawa Nature Park, plus you can enjoy the daily sunrise. The condo utilizes the eco-friendly design and stays relatively comfortable  and cool even without air conditioning. The comfort room has an exhaust vent system that helps remove moisture created by your shower. The shower is plumbed to accept a multi-port hot water heater. The kitchen is in place. All this condo needs are your personal touch.

Primavera City is designed as a sustainable, residential-commercial development that features eco-friendly natural light, building ventilation, common area solar energy, water recycling, rain harvesting and other green features. title: Dahilayan
address: Dahilayan, Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon, Northern Mindanao, Philippines
decriptions:
Mt. Pines – Your Mountain Retreat in Dahilayan! 

Escape to the cool, refreshing air of Mt. Pines in Dahilayan, where nature meets luxury living! 

Mountain Pines Farm is a subdivision spread out on 275 hectares of green hills and pine forests, located on one side of Mt. Kitanglad in Dahilayan, Manolo Fortich Bukidnon. Its developed by Abrown- the same developer of Xavier Estates in CDO. Its only an hour and 30 min drive from CDO city.

Here at Mountain Pines Farm, each lot is at least 700 square meters – ideal for a country house with a big garden. The soil here is good for planting strawberries and lettuce- the perfect getaway from the city. Its the perfect place to build that vacation home that you’ve been dreaming about.

Dahilayan is nestled at the foot of Mount Kitanglad, its 4,700 ft. above sea level. It has a cold climate, usually rains in the afternoons and is covered by fog in the late afternoons and early mornings. address: Lumbia, Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental, Northern Mindanao, Philippines
decriptions:
Arvesa Village: A New Residential Community in Lumbia, Cagayan de Oro

Description:

Cagayan de Oro’s Uptown District continues to expand as more residential communities rise to meet the growing demand for homes. One of the newest upcoming projects is Arvesa Village, a 4-hectare development by Johndorf Ventures, located in Sitio San Isidro, Barangay Lumbia.

Set to begin construction in 2027, Arvesa Village will feature 209 two-storey multiplex homes designed for individuals and families looking for accessible suburban living. With turnover expected in 2028, early interest allows buyers and investors to plan ahead and secure a spot in this growing community. Please note that turnover dates may change in the event of construction delays.

Location and Accessibility
Arvesa Village is positioned close to major establishments in Uptown CDO. Within a short drive, residents will have access to:
SM City CDO Uptown and Gaisano Uptown for shopping and dining
Corpus Christi School and Lumbia National High School for education
St. Francis Xavier Medical Clinic and CDO City Hospital (Lumbia Branch) for healthcare
Main roads leading to downtown CDO and nearby commercial districts
Its location balances convenience with a quieter suburban environment compared to the busier city center.

Development Details
Total Land Area: 4 hectares
Total Units: 209
Unit Type: 2-storey multiplex
Typical Lot Area: 60 sqm
Typical Floor Area: 64.85 sqm
Construction Start: 2027
Target Turnover: 2028

The site plan includes residential blocks, a clubhouse, open spaces, and recreational facilities, including a swimming pool and a basketball court.

Home Features
The project features multi-plex units with each unit having:
3 bedrooms
2 toilets and baths
Living and dining area with tiled finish
Kitchen with cabinets, countertop, and sink
Wood vinyl flooring for bedrooms
Balcony and lanai
Service area and two-car carport
The homes will be turned over with finished walls, floors, and ceilings, ready for customization based on the homeowner’s preferences.

Community Amenities
Arvesa Village will include shared spaces such as:
A clubhouse and swimming pool
Basketball court and playground
Landscaped open areas for recreation
These features aim to provide a sense of community while supporting an active lifestyle.

Sample Computation

Who Is It For?

Investors interested in pre-selling opportunities in a developing area

title: Aruga the Ideal Retirement Home for Expats
address: Mactan, Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, Central Visayas, Philippines
decriptions:
Nestled along the shores of Punta Engaño, Lapu-Lapu City, this exclusive 20-storey development by Rockwell Land spans 5.2 hectares with 270 meters of private white sand beachfront. The project was launched in 2018 with expected delivery for all the components in 2030. However, Tower 1 will be delivered in 2025 with the turn over currently ongoing. With only 276 units condo units, Aruga promises privacy, tranquility, and exclusivity.

The project is a township that will feature:

·      2 Residential Condos

·      1 Hotel

·      20 Beach front villas

For the condo units we have 4 unit types available.

Condo Units:

·      1‑Bedroom: 67–69 sqm

·      2‑Bedroom: 99–101 sqm

·      3‑Bedroom: 161–173 sqm

·      4‑Bedroom: 230–292 sqm

·       Villas: Spacious 131–298 sqm, perfect for full-blown island living.

Villas are currently sold out while Tower 1 is already 90% sold. However, if you are planning to get a unit you are not yet too late as Tower 2 is set to launch by 2025, together with the hotel. Target completion for Tower 2 and the hotel is in 2030.

Inclusions & Finish

Each unit at Aruga Resort & Residences – Mactan comes with premium finishes and thoughtfully selected fixtures. The kitchen is equipped with SMEG appliances, including a rangehood, cooktop, and oven, while all bedrooms, as well as the living and dining areas, are fitted with air conditioning. A washer and dryer are also provided, and for three-bedroom units and villas, a double-door refrigerator is included.

Storage and organization are enhanced with laminated modular cabinets by Mobil House, while the master toilet and bath feature porcelain tiles on the walls and floors, complemented by elegant Bianco Carrara natural stone countertops. Beachfront units offer additional touches of luxury, such as wooden slat ceiling accents, a headboard feature in the master bedroom, a full-length mirror in the toilet and bath, a mirror backsplash in the kitchen, and built-in cabinets in the living area.

Inclusions
·       SMEG kitchen appliances: rangehood, cooktop, oven

·       Air conditioning in all bedrooms, living, and dining areas

·       Washer and dryer

·       Laminated modular cabinets by Mobil House

·       Master toilet & bath: porcelain tiles on walls & floors

·       Bianco Carrara natural stone countertops

·       3-Bedroom & Villas: Double door refrigerator

Beachfront Unit Additions:

·       Wooden slat ceiling accents

·       Headboard accent in master bedroom

·       Full-length mirror in toilet & bath

·       Mirror backsplash in kitchen

·       Built-in cabinets in living area

Amenities
·       Grand lobby

·       Function room for events

·       Dining room / clubhouse

·       Game room (billiards)

·       Swimming pool for each tower

·       Gym

·       Sauna

·       Library

·       Lounge

·       Children’s play area

Aruga offers views of the Hilutungan Channel and its crystal-clear waters. Residents can take in 360-degree sea vistas. The property also overlooks Olango Island, a well-known ecological sanctuary that is home to a rich variety of migratory birds, adding a unique touch of natural beauty and biodiversity to the coastal landscape.

 It is a low-density luxury beachfront development seamlessly integrated with a resort hotel, offering residents an exclusive and private coastal living experience. Its prime location within Cebu’s top resort district positions it as a sought-after address for both lifestyle buyers and investors. With limited beachfront property supply, high tourism demand, and the prestige of the Rockwell brand, the development holds strong potential for capital appreciation and attractive rental income over the long term. 

Why Aruga Mactan is ideal for expats or foreigners looking to retire in the Philippines

Aruga Resort & Residences – Mactan is an ideal choice for foreigners looking to retire in the Philippines because it combines the comforts of luxury living with the relaxed atmosphere of a beachfront community. Located in Punta Engaño, one of Cebu’s most prestigious resort districts, it offers a secure, low-density environment with world-class amenities, private white sand beachfront, and panoramic ocean views.

The integration with a resort hotel ensures access to premium services while maintaining residential privacy. Its proximity to Mactan–Cebu International Airport makes travel convenient for both visiting family and international trips, while nearby healthcare facilities, leisure destinations, and dining options provide everything retirees need within easy reach.

 With Rockwell’s reputation for high-quality developments and excellent property management, Aruga offers a hassle-free, well-maintained home that can also generate rental income when not in use—making it both a lifestyle and investment choice for those seeking a peaceful yet connected retirement in the Philippines.

Work with an experience Real Estate Broker to get your Aruga Mactan Condo Unit

If you’re considering retirement in the Philippines or exploring beachfront property investments, now is the time to learn more about Aruga Resort & Residences – Mactan. Contact me for updated availability, floor plans, and sample computations, or to arrange a private viewing. Secure your place in one of Cebu’s most prestigious coastal addresses before Tower 2 launches in 2025.

title: Mt. Pines Farm Subdivision in Dahilayan
address: Dahilayan, Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon, Northern Mindanao, Philippines
decriptions:
Why Mt. Pines Farm Subdivision in Dahilayan Is the Perfect Retirement Option in Northern Mindanao

When we think of retirement, we imagine a life that’s slower, quieter, and filled with meaning—morning walks in nature, fresh air, and time to do what truly matters. If this resonates with you, then Mt. Pines Farm Subdivision in Dahilayan, Bukidnon could be your perfect retirement destination. Perched 4,000 feet above sea level, Mt. Pines Farm is set amidst a thriving pine forest and enjoys year-round cool temperatures. Here, you get to breathe clean mountain air every day, far from the heat and congestion of the city. Whether you're looking to stay active, garden, or simply relax, this climate is therapeutic—ideal for retirees who value both physical and mental well-being.

Tucked in Northern Mindanao’s most scenic mountain town, Mt. Pines Farm offers not just breathtaking views and crisp cool weather—but also a promising future, with wellness-focused developments, leisure, and comfort all in one place. It is fast becoming a popular eco-tourism destination, known for its adventure parks, lush scenery, and laid-back atmosphere. Yet, despite the tourist attractions nearby, Mt. Pines Farm remains serene and private—tucked away from the noise yet close enough for convenience.

You’re just 1.5 to 2 hours from Cagayan de Oro City, a short drive from Camp Philips, Manolo Fortich,andDel Monte Golf Courseandsurrounded bypine trees, flower farms, and organic produce sellers.

A Brown’s Vision: A Therapeutic Golf Course Next Door

What makes Mt. Pines Farm Phase 2B even more attractive is what’s coming next door: A Brown Company’s planned Therapeutic Golf Course—a one-of-a-kind development designed with seniors, beginners, and wellness seekers in mind.

This won’t be your typical competitive course. It’s designed to be inclusive, walkable, and healing, allowing residents to enjoy the health benefits of golf without the pressure of pro-level play.

Imagine… A short morning round of golf with mountain views Nature paths and low-impact physical activity An environment that encourages movement, connection, and rejuvenation

This golf course will soon become a centerpiece of retirement life in Dahilayan—blending leisure and wellness in a way that’s rarely seen in Mindanao.

Upscale Amenities: Two New Hotels Rising in the Area

As Dahilayan evolves into a lifestyle and leisure destination, hospitality infrastructure is quickly catching up.Just minutes from Mt. Pines Farm are two major hotel developments set to rise:

Grun Hotel

A boutique mountain resort concept that embraces eco-conscious luxury. Perfect for family visits, wellness retreats, and even short-term stays while building your home in Mt. Pines.

Dusit Princess Moena

An international hotel brand under Dusit Thani’s portfolio, this upscale hotel is expected to elevate the entire area’s tourism and investment value. With its Thai-inspired hospitality and wellness-centered services, it’s poised to attract both local and foreign retirees, investors, and weekenders.

These hotel developments signal a strong appreciation trajectory for properties in Mt. Pines—and a higher quality of life for its future residents.

Costa Mira Beachtown Tower 3 in Brgy. Subabasbas, Lapu-Lapu City, Mactan Island is part of Cebu Landmasters’ integrated coastal community. It blends modern condominium living with resort-inspired amenities, set against the backdrop of Cebu’s coastline.

Location and Accessibility

Costa Mira Beachtown is strategically located in Mactan, Cebu, a rapidly developing hub in the Visayas. From the project site, residents are:

4 minutes from Subabasbas Barangay Hall & Elementary School
11 minutes from Arc Hospital
13 minutes from Mactan Doctors’ Hospital
29 minutes from Mactan Cebu International Airport

Costa Mira Beachtown Tower 3 has a balance of accessibility to hospitals, schools, and the airport while being away from the urban congestion makes it an attractive residential and investment option.

Why Mactan Cebu is a Strong Retirement Choice for OFWs and Expats

Mactan has become one of the top residential and retirement destinations in the Philippines for several reasons:

1. Healthcare Access

Cebu is home to some of the country’s top hospitals, including Chong Hua Hospital Mandaue, Mactan Doctors’ Hospital, and Cebu Doctors’ University Hospital. For retirees and expats, the availability of English-speaking medical staff and affordable healthcare compared to Western countries is a major benefit.

2. Connectivity

The Mactan Cebu International Airport is less than 30 minutes away, offering direct international flights to hubs like Singapore, Hong Kong, Seoul, Tokyo, and Dubai. This makes it convenient for OFWs to visit family and for expats to travel regionally.

3. Cost of Living Advantage

Daily expenses, healthcare, and even domestic help are more affordable compared to Western countries. Retirees find they can maintain a comfortable lifestyle at a fraction of the cost in cities like Singapore or Los Angeles.

4. Resort Lifestyle

Mactan is known for its beaches, diving spots, and resort hotels, creating a perpetual vacation vibe. Many developments, like Costa Mira, are designed with resort-style amenities to complement this natural setting.

5. Growing Expat Community

Cebu and Mactan host an increasing number of foreign retirees and digital nomads, supported by the Special Resident Retiree’s Visa (SRRV) program. This community makes it easier for newcomers to integrate and feel at home.

6. Investment Growth

Aside from livability, Mactan has shown steady property value appreciation due to infrastructure projects such as the Cebu-Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX), which improves connectivity between Mactan and Cebu City. This dual benefit of lifestyle and investment growth appeals to OFWs planning long-term retirement.

address: San Pedro, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, MIMAROPA Region, Philippines
decriptions:
Palawan has long been recognized as one of the Philippines' most desirable destinations, known for its pristine beaches, world-famous islands, and relaxed lifestyle. For investors and homebuyers looking to own property in this tropical paradise, The Miren Enclaves by Dataland presents an exciting opportunity.

What is The Miren Enclaves?
The Miren Enclaves is a horizontal condominium development located along BM Road, Barangay San Pedro, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan. Developed by Dataland, the project sits on approximately 2 hectares of land and offers a unique residential concept that combines the privacy of a house with the convenience of condominium living.

Originally launched in 2019, the development is targeted for turnover in 2026, making it an attractive option for buyers seeking a pre-selling property with flexible payment terms.

Strategic Location
The Miren Enclaves enjoys a convenient location within Puerto Princesa City:

? Robinsons Place Palawan – approximately 1.7 km away (5-minute drive)

? Puerto Princesa International Airport – approximately 3.8 km away (10-minute drive)

Its accessibility makes it suitable for both end-users and investors targeting long-term or short-term rental markets.

Resort-Inspired Amenities
Residents can enjoy a range of thoughtfully designed amenities, including:

Adult Swimming Pool
Kiddie Pool
Clubhouse
Activity Lawn and Open Green Spaces
Children's Play Area
Off-Leash Pet Park
Dedicated Property Management Services

These amenities help create a resort-style environment while maintaining the property's long-term value.

Available Unit Types

Ideal for young professionals, retirees, and investors looking for rental income opportunities.

Parking spaces are also available for purchase at approximately ₱600,000 per slot.

Quality Unit Features
Units at The Miren Enclaves come with premium finishes and practical features, including:

Wood-grain floor tiles in living and dining areas
Granite kitchen countertops
Stainless steel kitchen sink
Built-in kitchen cabinets
Provision for range hood
Ceramic tiled bathrooms
Dual-flush water closet with bidet
Service sink
Lawn area for selected units

Flexible Payment Terms
One of the project's attractive features is its buyer-friendly payment scheme. For select units, buyers can reserve with a 10% down payment spread over 36 months, making ownership more accessible.

Is The Miren Enclaves Worth Considering?
For buyers seeking a property in one of the Philippines' most sought-after destinations, The Miren Enclaves offers a compelling combination of location, lifestyle, and investment potential.

Whether you're looking for a vacation home, retirement property, rental investment, or future residence in Palawan, this development deserves a place on your shortlist.
